items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: I got hold of the sax... I didn’t think of joining a band until I heard, her name is Lisa Brown. She was an alto sax player who was playing around in Boston... And I went to see her.

ctx.x: Were there role models for you, man or woman, coming up?

Yes there were. And that was a great big factor for me. What happened was that in the subsequent decade, that is when I was 32, my father died and I decided sort of the next day, if not right at the funeral, that now I’m going to also play the saxophone. And I got hold of the sax, it wasn’t his at the time, but I started practicing. But I didn’t think of joining a band until I heard, her name is Lisa Brown. She was an alto sax player who was playing around in Boston in some different Latin bands. And I went to…
Was it a tenor you started out on?
